question: Why is the protector of the field called the field-lord and described as consisting of that nature?
premises: Protection of the field grounds the title field-lord.
An emphatic identification with that nature is asserted.
inference: Therefore the one who protects the field is the field-lord and is identified as consisting of that nature.
uncertainties: The form -śavasyai is fragmentary and its syntactic role is unclear.
plain_english: Because one protects the field, one is called the lord of the field and indeed is of that very nature.
